holderQuote: He had known his Chieftain, Rags, when she was born. He’d followed her north, and then returned to Liscor, only to be captured at the end of the terrible battle. And he had a class Pebblesnatch had never encountered before.

The [Rotter] was in fact, a fermentation expert, a concept which Goblins understood, without the scientific terms. Holdnose had learned how to turn perfectly good food into a rotten—fermented, rather—substance.
